concerns.quote: Young people aged 16-17 are admitted to the Leeds Festival without any adult supervision
Illicit drugs are a fact of life at festivals such as this, despite the efforts made by the organiser to prevent them getting in, and to treat those who are harmed by them

The mixture of potentially vulnerable young people and available illicit drugs creates a tempting situation for these excited teenagers and exposes them to the potential harm which illicit drugs can inflict
concerns.hazard: exposure to illicit drugs by vulnerable youth

concerns.quote: As teenagers aged 16-17are not legally permitted to be in public houses or night clubs, it seems anomalous that they should be free to spend the while night in an environment where illicit drugs and alcoho! are prevalent
concerns.hazard: inconsistent legal access to age-restricted venues

concerns.quote: Evidence was given at Inquest by Miss [name redacted] mother that entry should be restricted to people under the age of 18
the casualty rate of those adversely affected by drugs is low when set against the huge numbers of young people attending
concerns.hazard: low casualty rate relative to attendance

reports.title: David Celino: Prevention of future deaths report
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths

concerns.quote: Neither the organiser of the festival (Festival Republic) nor Leeds City Council which licenced the event had accurate information about the number of people under 18 who were attending the festival
It was said in the course of the evidence that some 4-5 people die annually from illicit drug related causes at the various music festivals held in Britain
concerns.hazard: annual drug related deaths at music festivals

concerns.quote: Without reliable numbers, it is not possible to interrogate the data or establish what proportion of the drug related casualties belong to the under 18 cohort of attendees
concerns.hazard: inability to assess under 18 drug related casualties proportion

concerns.quote: The history of drug related deaths amongst teenagers at the Leeds Festival in recent years has prompted the organiser to explore a greater emphasis on deterrent measures
concerns.hazard: deterrent measures insufficient to prevent drug supply

concerns.quote: Evidence at the inquest indicated David Celino had walked about the Leeds Festival site between approximately 7pm and 8.45pm on the evening of Saturday 27 August 2022
concerns.hazard: lack of staff intervention during adverse drug reaction

concerns.hazard: lack of authoritative guidance on front of house drug testing
